title: RBI Shortens Local Area Banks Deposit Rate Relaxation to August 31, 2026
description: RBI amends Local Area Banks deposit directions, shortening temporary FCNR(B) and NRE interest-rate relaxations from September 30 to August 31, 2026.The post RBI Shortens Local Area Banks Deposit Rate Relaxation to August 31, 2026 appeared first on TaxGuru.
